description: The page's webview on iOS and Android. It now loads arbitrary sites, so the Bluetooth commands are granted for any http(s) origin — the same grant capabilities/content.json makes on a desktop. The toolbar commands are here too because the toolbar is injected into the page; none of them can reach another origin's grants. The chooser, the scanning prompt and the permissions view are deliberately absent: they live in their own windows, which is what keeps a site from painting over the consent step or enumerating what other sites hold.
